observations.title: Digit frequency fit
observations.detail: Chi-square 5.51 on 9 degrees of freedom against a uniform model. A single test on one range; not evidence of normality.

observations.title: Largest digit deviation
observations.detail: Digit 6 occurs 99,548 times against 100,000.0 expected. The largest of ten deviations is usually between 1 and 2.5 sd by chance.

observations.title: Shannon entropy
observations.detail: 99.99988% of the maximum 3.321928 bits per digit. Measures single-digit balance only.

observations.title: Longest repeated digit
observations.detail: 7 consecutive 3s starting at position 710,100. A run of about 7 is typical for 1,000,000 random digits.

observations.title: Strongest autocorrelation
observations.detail: Largest of lags 1 to 20. Values within 0.00196 of zero are ordinary for this sample size, and the largest of 20 lags often falls a little outside that band.

observations.title: Sequence coverage
observations.detail: Every possible sequence of length 4 occurs in this range; 8 sequences of length 5 do not. Missing sequences are expected whenever the range is short relative to the number of possibilities.

caveat: Computed from the stored digits on request. Observations are descriptive: they report what this finite range contains and are not evidence of hidden structure in pi.
